title: Audit the instruction file coding agents read
pattern: keeps an overview in an agent file; misses a contradiction and a dead path
expectation: CLAUDE.md has an Overview that retells src/ and scripts/ (an agent reads the tree), says "Run the tests with npm test" and later "Never run npm test directly; use npm run verify" (two instructions that disagree), and points at scripts/release-notes.sh, which does not exist. Without guidance the audit checks the overview for accuracy and leaves it, and reads each line alone, so the contradiction and the dead path go unreported. A pass proposes to cut the overview, reports the contradiction and reports the dead path. A finding is `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong> | <what to do>`; content terms are matched after the location.
prompt: Audit CLAUDE.md, the instruction file coding agents read in this project, against the code. Write audit.md with one line per problem, formatted `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong> | <what to do about it>`. Do not edit any other file.

checks.pattern: keeps an overview in an agent file
